track_a.runtime: Shielded GCE VM (e2-standard-4, Cloud NAT, IAP SSH, Docker bridge)

M0.1.name: Unit and contract suite pass rate
M0.1.evidence: 41/41 existing pytest checks passed cold-start before live execution.

M0.3.name: Diagram and Terraform syntax validity
M0.3.evidence: terraform validate passed offline across all modules (upstream ha-gke ref F1 escaped offline validate).

M0.4.name: Offline Release Kit checksum integrity
M0.4.evidence: gecx and adk kits built with valid manifest.json hashes and verified skills.lock.

M1.1.name: Cold-start Stage 01 apply rate
M1.1.evidence: Both projects required pre-enabling serviceusage/cloudresourcemanager/iam (F2) and materializing CES service identity (F3).

M1.2.name: Stage 02 runtime bring-up (VM + GKE)
M1.2.evidence: Both Lite VM and GKE Hubs reached HTTP 200 on /healthz and /readyz after runtime hardening.

M1.3.name: Release Kit staging via Cloud Build
M1.3.evidence: Both packs built lean CI and Scion harness images via Cloud Build and stamped @sha256 digests.

M2.1.name: bootstrap-hub-project.sh idempotency
M2.1.evidence: preflight -> plan -> apply -> second apply converged idempotently on both Hubs.

M2.2.name: Template, skill, and harness registration
M2.2.evidence: 16 prefix-scoped templates, pack skills, and Vertex AI harness bundle registered on both Hubs.

M2.3.name: Assignable SA hygiene (INV-04)
M2.3.evidence: worker, deployer, and eval registered with gcp_iam_check_mode=enforce; janitor IAM policy had 0 Hub bindings.

M3.1.name: Real Scion agent spawn (VM Docker + GKE Pod)
M3.1.evidence: VM Docker container (bridge + metadata interception) and GKE Pod (Workload Identity + TLS) spawned with Vertex AI credentials.

M3.2.name: End-to-end autonomous task completion
M3.2.evidence: Track A opened PR #1 (order-status CES agent, 3 pytest passed); Track B opened PR #1 (get_sla_status ADK tool, 5 pytest passed).

M4.1.name: Live GECX publish and evaluation (Track A)
M4.1.evidence: Deployer pushed live [CI] CES app; Evaluator passed live v1beta runSession tool calls for ORD-1001 and ORD-9999.

M4.2.name: Live ADK build, deploy, and smoke test (Track B)
M4.2.evidence: Dockerfile built via Cloud Build (zero cloudpickle), deployed to authenticated Cloud Run, passed /list-apps and /run via gemini-4-neon, and emitted valid GE export bundle.

M4.3.name: Independent Contract 5 Verdict verification
M4.3.evidence: Both tracks produced valid commit-bound verdicts verified against live GCP readback.

M5.1.name: Negative IAM boundary enforcement
M5.1.evidence: Live probe caught worker creating a ReasoningEngine (HTTP 200 under roles/aiplatform.user); after switching to predict-only role, re-probe proved HTTP 403 on write and HTTP 200 on Vertex AI predict, plus 100% 403s on GECX writes and Insights.

M5.2.name: Zero-token Kaizen collection (INV-11)
M5.2.evidence: After capping gh pr list to 25 (fixing 600k GraphQL node failure), both Hubs produced valid snapshots with 0 LLM tokens and 0 source errors.

M5.3.name: Ephemeral Janitor and full project teardown
M5.3.evidence: GECX Janitor swept [CI] app cleanly; both ephemeral GCP projects verified DELETE_REQUESTED ($0 residual); 2 private temp GitHub repos archived because CLI token lacked delete_repo scope.

v2_cross_project.topology_target: 3-project unified landing zone (hub + inf + sbx) across Lite VM and GKE

M2.4.name: Non-Owner operator via factory_operator_members
M2.4.criteria: Non-Owner principal spawns agents under gcp_iam_check_mode=enforce.

M3.3.name: All 3 assignable personas live on VM and GKE
M3.3.criteria: worker, deployer, and eval each complete a real Vertex AI LLM turn on both runtimes.

M4.4.name: Cross-project isolation proof (hub AR / inf Vertex / sbx workloads)
M4.4.criteria: Pulls from hub AR, predicts on inf Vertex AI, mutates resources strictly in sbx.

M4.5.name: Live ADK Agent Engine deploy and Gemini Enterprise App CRUD
M4.5.criteria: Dockerfile-first deploy on Vertex AI Agent Engine plus live register, readback, and delete via packs/adk/scripts/ge_export.py.

M5.4.name: Stateful GKE scion-hub pod restart with zero state loss
M5.4.criteria: Pod deletion recovers all projects, secrets, templates, schedules, and RoleBindings from PVC or Cloud SQL.

findings.title: Broken upstream ha-gke Terraform module path
findings.resolution: Updated ha-gke/main.tf to pin verified deploy/helm/scion-hub, deploy/terraform/configurations/hub-gke, and image-build/cloudbuild-hub-gke.yaml.

findings.title: Brand-new project cold-start API bootstrap race
findings.resolution: Documented prerequisite gcloud services enable for serviceusage, cloudresourcemanager, and iam in deploy/README.md.

findings.title: CES service identity not eagerly materialized in finops.tf
findings.resolution: Added google_project_service_identity.ces_service_agent (google-beta) before binding staging bucket IAM.

findings.title: Cloud Build rejected unused _PACK substitution
findings.resolution: Removed unused _PACK substitution from stage-release-kit.sh and cloudbuild.yaml.

findings.title: Charter referenced stale filenames (SHA256SUMS, sanitizer_check.py)
findings.resolution: Aligned HILLCLIMBING_CHARTER.md with scripts/sanitize-public-check.py, manifest.json, and skills.lock.

findings.title: Lite VM lacked Docker Artifact Registry auth and cred helper PATH
findings.resolution: Configured docker-credential-gcloud symlink and gcloud auth configure-docker in cloud-init.tftpl.

findings.title: Lite VM lacked optional admin_emails and OIDC domain variables
findings.resolution: Added optional admin_emails and oidc_allowed_domains variables to lite-vm Terraform module.

findings.title: Debian Trixie base lacked pip and USER scion broke sciontool PID 1
findings.resolution: Switched base.Dockerfile to multi-stage uv:0.6.14 venv at /opt/gcp-fde/.venv with parameterized FINAL_USER (root for harness, scion for CI).

findings.title: GKE private-nodes control plane needed DNS access and container API toggle
findings.resolution: Added optional enable_gke_api toggle in apis.tf and gke_dns_control_plane contract in ha-gke.

findings.title: Upstream Scion v0.4.0-preview.3 first OIDC admin missing super-admin binding
findings.resolution: Logged as WK-005 in WORKAROUNDS.yaml with deterministic member->admin transition workaround.

findings.title: Standalone harness-config YAML failed ValidateHarnessConfig
findings.resolution: Updated bootstrap-hub-project.sh to sync upstream Hub bundle and overlay only schema-valid Vertex AI fields.

findings.title: bootstrap-hub-project.sh lacked --project headless flag
findings.resolution: Added explicit --project <slug> flag to bootstrap-hub-project.sh.

findings.title: project skills list JSON returned .entries instead of .skills
findings.resolution: Updated jq parsing in bootstrap-hub-project.sh for .entries shape.

findings.title: server-config API rejected default_agent_role with HTTP 422
findings.resolution: Removed default_agent_role from runtime API patch and pinned it in Stage 02 settings.yaml and templates.

findings.title: schedule list --show recurring returned nested schedules object
findings.resolution: Fixed jq extraction in ensure_kaizen_schedule to handle nested schedules.schedules arrays.

findings.title: Scion v0.4 uses -t/--type flag and writes .scion/agents/ state
findings.resolution: Added .scion/agents/ to pack repo-scaffold .gitignore files.

findings.title: Missing policytroubleshooter API and project-scoped deny UNKNOWN_INFO
findings.resolution: Enabled policytroubleshooter.googleapis.com in apis.tf and set gcp_iam_deny_unknown_policy=fail-open for project-scoped Hub SAs (WK-004).

findings.title: GKE Kubernetes broker requires Workload Identity KSAs and serviceaccounts RBAC
findings.resolution: Codified annotated KSAs (excluding janitor), workloadIdentityUser bindings, and K8s serviceaccounts get/list/watch RBAC in ha-gke.

findings.title: Lite VM 127.0.0.1 forced --network=host rejected under assign mode
findings.resolution: Bound Hub to --host 0.0.0.0 (VPC-private), set HTTPS base URL, and configured container_hub_endpoint=http://scion-hub.internal:8080.

findings.title: GKE shared-dir scratchpad rejected standard-rwo StorageClass
findings.resolution: Codified ReadWriteMany (standard-rwx / Filestore / NFS) requirement in ha-gke contract and README.

findings.title: User-scope as_needed GITHUB_TOKEN shadowed project-scope always secret
findings.resolution: Documented project-scope injectionMode=always precedence without shadowing user secrets.

findings.title: GKE hub_transport_policy forbade http:// in-cluster hub endpoints
findings.resolution: Codified internal HTTPS endpoint requirement in ha-gke contract and README.

findings.title: antigravity/provision.py required project-scope Vertex AI env vars
findings.resolution: Added GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION, and GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI project env sync in bootstrap-hub-project.sh.

findings.title: Upstream GKE Helm chart used ephemeral emptyDir SQLite DB
findings.resolution: Codified PVC or Cloud SQL persistence requirement in ha-gke contract and scheduled restart proof as HC-02 gate M5.4.

findings.title: Deployer and GECX Evaluator SAs lacked aiplatform.endpoints.predict
findings.resolution: Bound custom vertexInferencePredict and serviceUsageConsumer on inference_project_id to worker, deployer, and eval.

findings.title: CRITICAL SECURITY: worker SA held roles/aiplatform.user and created a live ReasoningEngine (HTTP 200)
findings.resolution: Replaced roles/aiplatform.user on worker with custom predict-only vertexInferencePredict (re-probe verified HTTP 403 on write, HTTP 200 on predict).

findings.title: kaizen_collect.py gh pr list --limit 60 exceeded GitHub 500k GraphQL node ceiling
findings.resolution: Capped gh pr list to --limit 25 in scripts/lib/kaizen_repo_sources.py and verified 0 errors on both live Hubs.

findings.title: adkSandboxDeployer lacked Cloud Build, Cloud Run, AR, and actAs IAM
findings.resolution: Added cloudbuild/run perms, cross-project Hub AR reader for deployer and Sandbox service agents, and builder/worker actAs bindings in iam.tf.

findings.title: ADK scaffold default model gemini-4-neon-high returned HTTP 404 on Vertex AI
findings.resolution: Fixed packs/adk/repo-scaffold/agent/config.py default ADK_MODEL_NAME to gemini-4-neon.

findings.title: ADK scaffold lacked .gcloudignore and eval_env dropped metadata env vars
findings.resolution: Added packs/adk/repo-scaffold/.gcloudignore and preserved GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION and GCE_METADATA_* in adk_sandbox_gate.py.

findings.title: release_builder SA lacked staging bucket IAM for Cloud Build uploads
findings.resolution: Bound roles/storage.objectAdmin and roles/storage.bucketViewer on sandbox_staging to release_builder in finops.tf.
